title: Mixed7 Trio #10 (임산부+UV네온+바디페인팅)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Pregnant track): Ukrainian, in her late 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real pores, 3 clicker rings piercings with amethysts in copper-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, stacked of mixed-metal a ring. Painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic, a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of interlocking star-and-cross motifs wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals.

#2 (UV Neon track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, UV-reactive BLAZING long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — full body UV neon cosmic nebula bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold formations — BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA nebula cloud formations swirling across the chest and upper body, VIVID NEON CYAN plasma stream formations flowing down both legs, BLAZING NEON GOLD star cluster formations filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed. Under her own dedicated UV blacklight spot, zero white light reaching her specifically. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails BLAZING NEON UV reactive tips.

#3 (Bodypaint track): a real adult Indian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, sultry, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), wide gold-and-crimson bands following every deep crease, dense jewel-toned scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Footwear: extreme gold-and-crimson extreme platform clear heels.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
